SELECT 100.0*AVG((close_reason='take_profit')::int) AS v FROM (SELECT * FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}') trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS(tp_price-entry_price)/NULLIF(ABS(entry_price-sl_price),0)),2) AS v FROM (SELECT * FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}') trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(hold_candles),2) AS v FROM (SELECT * FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}') trades WHERE exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT t.close_reason, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.hi - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.lo)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS avg_mfe_pct, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.lo - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.hi)/t.entry_price*100 END),3) AS avg_mae_pct, ROUND(AVG((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0)),2) AS avg_realized_r, ROUND(AVG(t.hold_candles),1) AS avg_hold, ROUND(SUM(t.pnl_net_usdt),4) AS net_pnl FROM (SELECT * FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}') t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM (SELECT * FROM candles WHERE env = '${env}') candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.close_reason ORDER BY trades DESC

SELECT to_timestamp(t.entry_ts/1000.0) AS entry_time, to_timestamp(t.exit_ts/1000.0) AS exit_time, t.pair, t.direction AS dir, t.leverage AS lev, ROUND(t.entry_price,8) AS entry, ROUND(t.exit_price,8) AS exit, ROUND(t.tp_price,8) AS tp, ROUND(t.sl_price,8) AS sl, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END,8) AS points, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.exit_price-t.entry_price)/t.entry_price ELSE (t.entry_price-t.exit_price)/t.entry_price END*100,3) AS move_pct, ROUND((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN t.exit_price-t.entry_price ELSE t.entry_price-t.exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0),2) AS r_mult, ROUND(ABS(t.tp_price-t.entry_price)/NULLIF(ABS(t.entry_price - t.sl_price),0),2) AS plan_rr, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.hi - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.lo)/t.entry_price*100 END,3) AS mfe_pct, ROUND(CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (px.lo - t.entry_price)/t.entry_price*100 ELSE (t.entry_price - px.hi)/t.entry_price*100 END,3) AS mae_pct, t.hold_candles AS candles, ROUND((t.exit_ts-t.entry_ts)/60000.0,0) AS dur_min, ROUND(t.fee_entry_usdt+COALESCE(t.fee_exit_usdt,0),4) AS fees, ROUND(t.pnl_net_usdt,4) AS net_pnl, ROUND(t.pnl_pct,2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(ABS(t.entry_price-t.liquidation_price)/t.entry_price*100,2) AS liq_dist_pct, ROUND(t.bucket_balance_after,4) AS bal_after, t.close_reason AS reason, t.pattern FROM (SELECT * FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}') t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(high) AS hi, MIN(low) AS lo FROM (SELECT * FROM candles WHERE env = '${env}') candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts AND t.exit_ts) px ON true WHERE t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.exit_ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE env = '${env}') events WHERE level IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000

SELECT category AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE env = '${env}') events WHERE ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000 GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT level AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE env = '${env}') events WHERE ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000 GROUP BY level ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT split_part(message,':',2) AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE env = '${env}') events WHERE category='signal' AND message LIKE 'signal_rejected:%' AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000 GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT to_timestamp((ts/3600000)*3600) AS "time", category AS metric, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE env = '${env}') events WHERE to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY (ts/3600000), category ORDER BY 1
